items.name: FMC Corp.
items.headline: Slashes Q3 revenue and EBITDA guidance on channel price resets
items.catalyst: FMC cut its Q3 revenue outlook to $65 million–$125 million and adjusted EBITDA to negative $565 million–$510 million, from July guidance of $840 million–$900 million and $120 million–$140 million, citing a $625 million–$675 million impact from commercial actions.
items.thesis: Management is choosing to absorb a one-quarter collapse to reprice inventory held by distributors, which should reduce rebate-driven distortions going forward. The open questions are the size of the coming impairment, covenant headroom, and what the 2027–2028 framework due Oct. 30 implies for earnings power after generics.

items.name: Penske Automotive Group
items.headline: Agrees to $212-a-share cash take-private by Penske Corp. and Mitsui
items.catalyst: Penske Automotive agreed to be acquired for $212.00 per share in cash by a buyer owned by Penske Corporation and Mitsui, an enterprise value of about $16.3 billion, with closing expected in the first quarter of 2027.
items.thesis: With a fixed cash price on the table, the shares now trade on deal certainty rather than auto retail fundamentals. The majority-of-the-minority vote and regulatory approvals are the key hurdles to watch.

items.name: Rocket Lab
items.headline: Neutron's inaugural launch now expected in 2027
items.catalyst: Rocket Lab said after the Oct. 14 close that Neutron's inaugural launch is now expected to occur in 2027 under an adjusted schedule.
items.thesis: A schedule slip on a flagship development program pushes out a milestone investors have been tracking closely. The absence of a stated reason in the release leaves investors to the accompanying presentation for detail.
items.source_name: Rocket Lab investor relations release, Oct. 14, 2026

items.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 50.9%; Q4 guided to $52.3B–$54.3B
items.catalyst: TSMC reported Q3 revenue of NT$1,494.24 billion (US$46.72 billion), up 50.9% in NT$ terms, with diluted EPS up 68.7% to NT$29.43, and guided Q4 revenue to US$52.3 billion to US$54.3 billion.
items.thesis: The numbers confirm leading-edge demand is still growing strongly, with 3nm and 5nm at 61% of wafer revenue and a 2nm ramp ahead. With expectations already high across AI hardware, trading reaction is likely to hinge on margins and capex commentary rather than the beat itself.
items.correction: Clarified that 50.9% growth is in NT$ terms and replaced 'still accelerating' since guided Q4 sequential growth (+14.1%) is below Q3's 16.2%.

items.name: Charles Schwab
items.headline: Record Q3 revenue and core net new assets of $190.4B
items.catalyst: Schwab reported Q3 total net revenues of $7.171 billion versus $6.135 billion a year earlier and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.62 versus $1.26.
items.thesis: Growth is coming from both client asset gathering and net interest revenue, which rose to $3.476 billion. The question for the stock is less the quarter than how sticky client cash balances and trading activity prove if markets stay volatile.
items.source_name: Charles Schwab Q3 2026 earnings release (Business Wire)

items.name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
items.headline: Prices $200M share sale alongside pipeline data and a Sanofi option
items.catalyst: An Oct. 15 8-K disclosed an underwritten sale of 61.54 million shares at $3.25 for about $200 million gross, a Sanofi option triggering a $10 million milestone, and early REC-4881 and REC-1245 trial data.
items.thesis: The company says cash plus the offering funds operations into 2029, removing a near-term financing overhang. The trade-off is dilution, and the clinical readouts remain early, with a registrational REC-4881 trial planned for 2027 pending FDA discussions.

items.name: ManpowerGroup
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 5.2% in constant currency; Q4 EPS guided $1.03–$1.13
items.catalyst: ManpowerGroup reported Q3 revenues of $4.84 billion versus $4.63 billion, diluted EPS of $0.71 versus $0.38 and adjusted EPS of $1.01, and guided Q4 diluted EPS to $1.03–$1.13.
items.thesis: Revenue growth and management talk of improving demand are constructive for an early-cycle business. The Q4 range is the near-term yardstick for whether that demand converts into earnings.

items.name: Prologis
items.headline: Q3 core FFO up to $1.60 a share; net EPS guidance cut
items.catalyst: Prologis reported Q3 core FFO of $1.60 per share versus $1.49, 95.1% average occupancy and 60 million square feet of leases signed, and moved 2026 net EPS guidance to $4.05–$4.15 from $4.40–$4.55.
items.thesis: Operating metrics and a raised core FFO midpoint point to steady warehouse demand. The lower net EPS range is a GAAP item to reconcile against the stronger core numbers.

items.name: PNC Financial Services
items.headline: Q3 EPS of $4.97 as net interest income rises 15%
items.catalyst: PNC earned $2.10 billion, or $4.97 a diluted share ($5.09 adjusted), versus $4.35 a year earlier, on revenue of $6.56 billion; net interest income rose 15% while noninterest income fell 15% from Q2.
items.thesis: Spread income is carrying results while capital markets revenue cooled sequentially. Rising net charge-offs and a lower CET1 ratio are the details investors are likely to weigh against the earnings growth.
items.source_name: PNC Financial Services Group, Q3 2026 earnings release

items.name: U.S. Bancorp
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises to $1.34 on fee growth and better efficiency
items.catalyst: U.S. Bancorp's Q3 net income rose to $2.20 billion, or $1.34 a diluted share, from $1.22, with noninterest income up 13.1% and the efficiency ratio at 55.9% versus 57.2%.
items.thesis: Fee momentum and improving efficiency are the positive read, while the $135 million initial provision for an acquired card book is a one-time accounting item. Zero buybacks in the quarter keeps the capital return question open.
